title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode18 Their Curse

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank goodness! We found you!
Why?
Miku, did you bring them here?
Why did you come back?
I told you to leave me alone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I came because I want you to listen to my song.
Your song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You said before that my music wasn't enough.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
So I made another song.
One that will be able to save you this time.
I don't need it anymore.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yuki.
Just leave me alone.
Miku, get them out of here.
Miku, did you hear me? Hurry up and get rid of these two.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Listen to it.
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Listen...to her song.
Not you too... Why?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Please, Yuki.
Go away! I just want to be left alone so I can disappear!
I don't want your help!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: K, your phone!
Now get out...
Stop barging in here when you don't know a single thing about me!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I do know.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You said it yourself, Yuki.
You accused us all of wanting to disappear.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You were right. I want to disappear so badly I don't know what to do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All because my music caused the person I care for most to suffer.
You what?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My dad used to be a songwriter.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: He worked so hard, always hoping that his music would bring people happiness.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wanted to be like him, so I started writing songs myself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But the songs I wrote only pushed my dad into a corner.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Your songs...did that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. He had suffered for so long because the songs he made were old and nobody wanted them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I kept making him listen to my music, not realizing he was forcing himself to smile as he did.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That just made things worse. It forced him to think about the fact he wasn't able to write music like mine.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: He lost confidence in himself and ended up collapsing from the pressure. And now he can't make music anymore.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's terrible. But is it really your fault, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's my fault. I'm the one who hurt him. I took away the music he loved so much, and his future with it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I started wanting to disappear so badly it hurt.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But my dad told me that I had to keep creating music. That's...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's the only thing keeping me going.
I have to keep writing music that can save others.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Songs that can rescue them no matter how hopeless they feel. So even though I just want to disappear, I have to keep composing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... I understand how you feel, Yuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Though our situations might be a little different.
I...see.
You've been cursed by your own father, K.
A curse you can never be free of. How sad.
But I don't give a damn about your curse, so don't get me involved in your problems.
You're only trying to save me because you want to help yourself. A vain, desperate struggle.
All that will do is make us both suffer.
After all, the truth is you just want to disappear.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That may be true, but still...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe those shared feelings are why your song was the only thing able to get through.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even if it wasn't enough...it still reached her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I learned that the song I wrote reached you, Yuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's why I want to save you with my music.
As long as there is still a chance, I will save you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even if this is a curse.
